Container.Name: embroidery-converter
Container.Overview: Browser-only viewer and converter for PES, DST, JEF, EXP and VP3 embroidery files. The container serves a static web page; conversion runs in the visitor's browser, so embroidery files never leave the device and nothing is uploaded to the server. The converter is a TypeScript port of pystitch, the library Ink/Stitch uses, tested against it on a synthetic corpus (the writers give the same bytes and the readers the same stitches, with documented exceptions), and is free and MIT licensed. Limits: 1,000,000 stitches or 30 MB per file. Made by MavenWright, the team behind StitchKit (a commercial embroidery app). Set SHOW_CREDIT to false to remove the optional footer link. No volumes or persistent data are needed.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: embroidery pes dst jef exp vp3 stitch converter viewer

Config.Name: WebUI Port
Config.Description: Port the converter page is served on (the container listens on 8080).

Config.Name: Show credit
Config.Description: true shows the optional "Edit in StitchKit" footer link. false, 0 or no removes it.
